name: 5-card Brag
description: Five Card Brag: each player gets five cards and discards two to make a three-card hand. Hand rankings as in 3-Card Brag (prial, running flush, flush, run, pair, high card). Betting and bluffing; blind play for double stakes. British gambling game.

overview.description: Five Card Brag: each player gets five cards and discards two to make a three-card hand. Hand rankings as in 3-Card Brag (prial, running flush, flush, run, pair, high card). Betting and bluffing; blind play for double stakes. British gambling game.

history.origins: Five-card Brag is a British vying game in the Brag family, which dates to the 18th century (described by Hoyle) and descends from Primero and Post and Pair. It extends Three-card Brag by dealing five cards per player; each discards two to form a three-card Brag hand, with the same hand rankings and blind-betting rules as the parent game.
timeline: 20th century: Five-card Brag documented as a simple extension of Three-card Brag, dealing five cards and discarding two to keep a three-card hand.

setup.deck: Standard 52-card pack without jokers; ranks in each suit run A-K-Q-J-10 down to 2.
setup.dealing: Five cards each; each discards two.

rules.objective: Best three-card hand (from five dealt, discard two) at showdown, or bluff all to fold.
rules.gameplay: Ante; deal 5, discard 2. Betting; blind pays double. Showdown: prial highest, then running flush, flush, run, pair, high.

strategy.basic: Select best three from five; bluff.
strategy.intermediate: Choose which three to keep (best combination); bluff when you have a pair or run.
strategy.advanced: Blind for double when pot is large; read opponents' bet sizing.
tips: 5 cards, discard 2, play 3; same rankings as 3-Card Brag.
Prial (three of a kind) beats running flush.

variations.name: Four-card Brag
variations.description: Each player receives four cards and discards one to make the best three-card Brag hand; betting structure and hand rankings follow standard Brag rules.
variations.emptyOverridesReason: Engine overrides are not encoded separately; this variant is documented for rules reference only.

variations.name: Three-card Brag
variations.description: The classic British Brag game: three cards per player, blind and seen betting, with prial, running flush, run, flush, pair, and high card hand rankings.
variations.emptyOverridesReason: Core engine for three-card Brag is shared elsewhere; this entry records the relationship as a family variant.

variations.name: Seven-card Brag
variations.description: Players receive seven cards and arrange them into multiple Brag-style hands (for example 3-3-1), with back hands required to beat middle and front layouts.
variations.emptyOverridesReason: Layout and scoring differences are described in rules; engine-level overrides are deferred to a dedicated game entry.

variations.name: Nine- and Thirteen-card Brag (Crash)
variations.description: Multi-hand Brag variants where nine or thirteen cards are dealt and split into several three-card Brag hands, often played as Crash with separate pots for each hand.
variations.emptyOverridesReason: Crash-style multi-hand play is modeled in separate entries; this variation is kept here to connect Five-card Brag to the wider Brag family.

scoring.winCondition: Best three-card hand (from five dealt, discard two) at showdown, or bluff all to fold.
